purpose: Append-only RESEARCH ledger for E0/E1 screens. This is a THIN DISCOVERY LAYER in front of the existing harness, NOT a new experiment framework. E0/E1 records here are non-claiming and may never be cited as results. On promotion to E2 an idea receives an experiment_id and enters experiments/registry.jsonl under the unchanged pre-registration rule.
hard_rule: GRAPH_POLICY 13.2 -- E0/E1 run ONLY on the exploration partition and NEVER read, join, plot or describe the E2 confirmation holdout. This is what makes screening many ideas statistically free rather than a machine for false confidence.
promotion_disclosure: an E2 preregistration states how many E0 leads its campaign screened (GRAPH_POLICY 13.3), so a reader can distinguish a 1-of-50 survivor from a 1-of-2 survivor
do_not: do not build tooling around this file before using it. Append with a two-line script. The failure mode this whole directive exists to prevent is spending another 948 minutes on machinery.
